title: Bland AI Pricing: $0.14 a Minute Until Your 101st Call a Day
meta_description: Bland AI is $0.14 a minute on Start, $299 a month plus $0.12 on Build. Start stops at 100 calls a day; unless calls run long, that cap forces the upgrade.

image.takeaway: Bland’s Start plan stops at 100 calls a day; the 101st call needs Build at $299 a month.
image.alt: Bland AI pricing: $0.14 a minute on Start with no monthly fee, $299 a month plus $0.12 a minute on Build, and a cap of 100 calls a day on Start
